question: Which of the following country follow more than one time zones?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A time zone **is a **region **of the **globe **that **observes **a **uniform standard time **for **legal**, **commercial**, and **social purposes**.
 
• **Time zones **tend to **follow **the **boundaries **of **countries **and **their subdivisions **because it **is convenient for areas **in close **commercial or other communication **to keep the **same time**.
 
• **Time **in the **United States**, by law, is divided into **nine standard time zones **covering the states, **territories**, and other **US possessions.**
 
• The **USA has 9 time zones**:
 
 
• Atlantic, Eastern Central Mountain, Pacific, Alaska, Hawaii, American, and Chamorro.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Argentina **is **located **at a **longitude **that would **naturally put it in the UTC−04:00 **or UTC**−05:00 **time zone; however, it actually uses the **UTC−03:00 time zone**.
 
• **China covers five time zones **(Zhongyuan, Longshu, Tibet, Kunlun, and Changbai Time Zones.
 
• **India **has only **one-time zone**. The country has officially observed India Standard Time (IST) since 1947.
